description: Where the domain from set_domain stands, checked again now: `kind` is none (no domain is asked for), pending (waiting on DNS), live (it serves the site); while it is pending, `records` holds the DNS records still missing. DNS can take an hour to be seen; call again later rather than in a loop.

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: domain_status
title: Domain status
